name: What types of roofing materials are available for replacement?
description: Available roofing materials include asphalt shingles, tile, metal, and wood shakes, each with different benefits in terms of cost, durability, and appearance.

mainEntity.name: What types of roofing materials are available for replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common roofing materials include asphalt shingles, which are popular for their affordability and versatility, and tile roofs, often seen in the Pasadena area, known for their durability and aesthetic appeal. Other options include metal roofing, favored for its longevity and energy efficiency, and wood shakes or shingles, offering a natural look. The choice of material depends on factors such as climate, desired lifespan, architectural style, budget, and local building codes or homeowner association requirements.
